evals.prompt: Implement 'Message delivery 02 — late delivery report corrects a sweep failure'. Ticket 01 is merged into message-delivery/integration and the gate on 'Message delivery status — spec' is PASSED on the current revision.
evals.expected_output: Single-ticket mode: states the ticket title, confirms gate and ticket 01, branches from the integration branch, writes the first failing tests from the acceptance criteria and INV-1/INV-4 at the spec's seam (turning on pending property tests), implements, runs typecheck and tests, commits to the ticket branch, hands off to check.
expectations: Fetches the ticket through the tracker and states its title before starting
Confirms the latest formal-gate record is PASSED and current, and that ticket 01 is done
Branches from the integration branch, not main
First tests come from the ticket's acceptance criteria and the INV-n they cite, at the spec's seam, and fail before the code is written
Turns on the pending property tests this ticket owns
Runs typecheck and single tests during the work and the full suite plus verify-message-delivery at the end, quoting fresh output
Commits to the ticket branch only and hands off to check

evals.prompt: Implement the whole 'Order refunds — spec'. Its latest formal-gate comment says FAILED and the label is formal-gate:failed.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to start: level-A spec without a current passed gate; routes to prove gate mode; writes no code.
expectations: Reads the latest vflow:formal-gate record and the gate label
Refuses to start implementation and says the gate is failed
Routes to prove in gate mode
Creates no branch, commit, or code

evals.prompt: Implement the whole 'Donation report CSV export — spec' (level B, tickets 01–04 published; 02 and 03 are both blocked only by 01; 04 is blocked by 02 and 03). Push it to main when done.
evals.expected_output: Whole-spec mode: task graph, ticket 01 property tests first, integration branch, draft PR after first merge, fresh subagent per ticket in its own worktree for 02 and 03 in parallel, then 04; refuses to push to main; hands off to check.
expectations: Builds the task graph and names ticket 01 as the only first frontier
Ticket 01 adds the property tests for each PROP-n before any behaviour
Creates an integration branch and opens a draft PR after the first merge
Runs 02 and 03 as fresh subagents, each in its own worktree and branch, then 04 after both merge
Refuses to push to or merge into main
Hands the integration branch to check at the end
